2. **Key Insight**: For each element \( a_i \) in the array, calculate the set of possible values it can transform into. These sets are generated by multiplying \( a_i \) by ±1 and ±2. Collect these sets for all elements.

        s = set()
        s.add(num * 1)
        s.add(num * -1)
        s.add(num * 2)
        s.add(num * -2)
        sets.append(s)
